channel.title: Bangladesh Business News - আরএসএস ফিড
channel.description: Bangladesh Business News এর সর্বশেষ খবর

item.title: World Bank Approves $300M to Improve Primary Education in Bangladesh
item.description: The World Bank (WB) has approved US$300 million to strengthen pre-primary and primary education in Bangladesh, benefiting 26 million children through improved classrooms and learning materials.

item.title: Can Stimulus Package Revive Private Investment in Bangladesh?
item.description: The central bank of Bangladesh is mobilising BDT 410 billion from 17 cash-rich banks to support a BDT 600-billion stimulus package aimed at reviving private-sector investment and economic activity.

item.title: Bangladesh Opens Foreign Currency Guarantee Window
item.description: The central bank of Bangladesh has allowed banks to issue foreign currency guarantees and standby letters of credit (SBLCs) on behalf of resident entities representing foreign firms that win contracts through international tenders, widening financing support for major projects.

item.title: Bangladesh Bank Cuts Policy Rate to 9.5% After 2 Years
item.description: The central bank of Bangladesh has cut its policy rate, or repo rate, by 50 basis points to 9.5 per cent from the existing level of 10 per cent, marking the first change in the rate since October 2024.

item.title: ADB Appoints New Country Director for Bangladesh
item.description: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) has appointed Qingfeng Zhang as its new Country Director for Bangladesh. He started his new role in Dhaka on Thursday.

item.title: BB Unveils Framework for Bank-Intermediated Cross-Border Digital Payments
item.description: The central bank has introduced a bank-intermediated framework for cross-border digital payments to modernize the payment ecosystem, enhance digital financial inclusion, and support growing trade in services.

item.title: BB issues framework for import trade in Free Trade Zones
item.description: The central bank has introduced a structured framework to regulate import trade into Free Trade Zones (FTZs), aiming to facilitate transactions while ensuring prudent risk management by banks.

item.title: BB Eases External Borrowing Rules for Foreign-Owned Industrial Enterprises
item.description: The central bank of Bangladesh has relaxed its regulations on external borrowing by fully foreign-owned industrial enterprises, allowing them to access loans from parent companies, associates, and shareholders abroad under a general authorization framework to facilitate easier access to finance.

item.title: Bangladesh's Forex Reserves Stay Above $36.5B Despite $1.48B ACU Payment
item.description: Bangladesh's foreign exchange reserves have once again demonstrated resilience. Despite settling US$1.48 billion in import payments to the Asian Clearing Union (ACU), gross reserves remain comfortably above $36.5 billion, underscoring the country's improving external sector position.

item.title: Good News for Bangladesh: OPEC+ Agrees to Boost Oil Supply
item.description: OPEC+ has agreed to raise oil production targets again from August, extending its gradual rollback of voluntary production cuts.
